title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: edhoc.rs - responder and test th_4 calls broken
description:
Commit 1f14bc35 fixed the initiator `transcript_4` call to use `plaintext_3` (pre-encryption) instead of encrypted `ciphertext_3.0` for `th_4` computation, which matches the EDHOC spec (th_4 = H(th_3, PLAINTEXT_3)).

However, two other call sites in the same file remain broken:

1. **Responder (line 1345)**: calls `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &pending.plaintext, peer.credential)` — 3 args when the function only takes 2. This fails under `--all-features` with E0061.
2. **Test (line 1635)**: same 3-arg issue: `transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i)`.

Both should be fixed to match the initiator pattern (2-arg call with plaintext only).

Also: the fix was never verified by compilation because `edhoc` is not a default feature (gated behind `#[cfg(feature = "edhoc")]`). Running `cargo check -p lichen-oscore --all-features` reveals 56 compilation errors in this file — it is in a mid-refactor state.
